paragraphs.source_en: Just how badly could the ship have been damaged to make repairs impossible? Puzzled, O-Mitsu made her way toward the shore. She was bound for a teahouse near Yamato Bridge. Today she was to meet one of Chaya Seiji's men. At Hon'ami Kōetsu's request, the man had investigated the sinking of the Portuguese ship at Nagasaki and sought news of O-Kō, who lived in Hachiōji Chōan's inner household. After hearing his report, O-Mitsu intended to take a Yodoya boat straight to Kyoto to see Kōetsu.
